title: SEAFact-Bench: Budget-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Fact-Checking for Malay and Vietnamese (code and results)
description:
Code, pre-registration file and results of the paper Budget-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Fact-Checking for Malay and Vietnamese: A Pre-Registered Benchmark of Evidence Retrieval, Early-Exit Re-Ranking, and Verdict Prediction (I. Mohd Jamadi and S. Anuar, manuscript under review, 2026).

The Google Colab notebook builds the Southeast Asian Fact-checking Benchmark (SEAFact-Bench) from openly downloadable datasets (SEBENARNYA-Fact, ViFactCheck, X-FACT and SciFact) and runs every experiment of the paper: first-stage retrieval, cross-encoder re-ranking under a compute budget, verdict prediction with gold and retrieved evidence, and abstention. The notebook is saved with the outputs of the registered run (pre-registration SHA-256 705661ed59fa21f22f4d62070131c95cd94d1dd0eb108de4fc637dc99db74cfa). The archive also contains all result tables, per-query results and the scripts that produce the figures and the title-cue analysis of the paper. No dataset is redistributed.
